title: Climate financing and the pursuit of SDGs 7 and 13: a strategic pathway to net-zero emissions in Nigeria
core_idea: Examine how mobilizing and directing climate finance can support achievement of SDG 7 (affordable and clean energy) and SDG 13 (climate action) as a strategic route toward attaining net-zero emissions in Nigeria.
tldr: The paper investigates the role of climate financing in advancing SDGs 7 and 13 to create a strategic pathway to net-zero emissions in Nigeria.
